bs-countthings-error-invalid-mode: Qaabka "$1" waa mid aan sax ahayn. Fadlan isticmaal "chars", "words", ama "pages".
bs-countthings-tag-countarticles-desc: Waxay soo bandhigtaa tirada maqaallada ku jira wiki-ga.
bs-countthings-tag-countfiles-desc: Waxay soo bandhigtaa tirada faylasha ku jira wiki-ga.
bs-countthings-tag-countcharacters-desc: Waxay soo saartaa xogta qeexaysa nuxurka maqaalka la tilmaamay. Soo saarku waa sanduuq xogeed oo lagu dhex dari karo maqaal. Iyada oo la adeegsanayo xuduudda "mode", waxaa la soo bandhigi karaa noocyo kala duwan oo macluumaad ah.
bs-countthings-droplet-characters-descri: Waxay muujisaa tirada xarfaha ama ereyada ku jira bogga wiki-ga
bs-countthings-droplet-files-description: Waxay muujisaa tirada dhammaan faylasha la soo geliyey
bs-countthings-tag-countcharacters-desc-: Sheeg waxa la tirinayo: wax kasta, xarfaha, ereyada, xarfaha iyo ereyada, ama bogagga
